prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. Over eight visits, care consisted of spinal examination, range-of-motion assessment, soft tissue treatment, and a home stretching program. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which are consistent with a lumbar strain. Straight leg raise and neurological screening were within normal limits, and no radicular signs were identified. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Causation of the current findings relative to this collision has not yet been clearly established. Recovery has progressed more slowly than typically expected for a strain of this type, and the plan is to reassess function and the need for continued care at the next visit. Billing records for two similar charges on the same day are under review by the office and are not addressed in this clinical summary.
